notes.title: Matsudaira's Myoshu Now Available!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of "Matsudaira's Myoshu," an immersive village builder set in the tumultuous Sengoku period of Japan. Step back in time and take on the role of a myoshu for the daimyo Matsudaira Hirotada, where you'll transform a small hamlet into a thriving, fortified stronghold.

Immerse yourself in the rich historical era, managing resources, building structures, and defending against threats like ronin, raiders, and stealthy ninja. Engage in exhilarating combat, shrewd trading, and intricate village management, all while navigating a dynamic day/night cycle and seasonal festivals that bring your village to life.

With a comprehensive research tree and various challenges to test your leadership skills, "Matsudaira's Myoshu" offers endless opportunities to shape the destiny of your people. Will you rise to become a legendary myoshu, leaving an enduring mark on history?

Join us on this epic journey and purchase "Matsudaira's Myoshu" today! Available now on Steam. Your village awaits its leader—are you ready to build, protect, and prosper?

notes.title: Steam Page Localization!
notes.notes:
I'm delighted to share some fantastic news with you all! Matsudaira's Myoshu's Steam page has undergone a significant update, making it accessible in multiple languages. You can now explore the Steam page in the following languages:

Spanish
French
German
Chinese (Simplified)
Japanese
Russian
Portuguese (Brazilian)

This page update aims to enhance your browsing experience, allowing you to engage with Matsudaira's Myoshu's content, news, and community discussions in your preferred language. While the game remains in English, I hope this localization effort enhances your overall experience and fosters a stronger sense of community among the players worldwide.

Thank you for your continued support, and I look forward to seeing you flourish as a feudal lord in Matsudaira's Myoshu!

notes.title: 0.4 Update and finishing up
notes.notes: Konnichiwa! Hello! Introducing the latest update, 0.4, of Matsudaira's Myoshu: A Sengoku Village Simulator! Prepare to immerse yourself in a historic land brimming with new features, including a dynamic weather system, a Myoshu welcome celebration was added, and a new intro movie to introduce you to your goals. Examine the new vibrant landscapes teeming with flora, each coded with a different hue to give variety. We added a plethora of new achievements bringing the total to 42! We also have been fine tuning and balancing the game as well as hunting down any final pesky bugs. And good news! This is the last update planned before our highly anticipated demo release for June NextFest! Secure your spot in history by wishlisting the game on Steam today and give the demo a try for NextFest June 10-17!

notes.title: 0.3 Release and final phase of beta testing!
notes.notes: Tons of bug fixes and final balancing and a new intro movie! We are also entering the final phase of beta testing before NextFest! Wishlist the game to stay informed and I look forward to seeing you all during NextFest!

notes.title: Textile Tales and Enhanced Communication Await in Okazaki!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Myoshu! Prepare to embark on a journey woven with new threads of excitement in "Matsudaira's Myoshu: A Sengoku Village Simulator." We're thrilled to introduce a host of captivating updates designed to enrich your experience in the heart of Sengoku.

Tailoring Research Unveiled:
Dive into the realm of Tailoring Research, where the delicate art of textile craftsmanship awaits. Cultivate cotton farms, erect tailor buildings, and with advanced silk research, craft elegant kimonos to dazzle traders and enhance your village's prestige. The fabric of your village's legacy awaits your skilled hands.

Streamlined Feedback and Bug Submission:
Communication is key in the evolving landscape of Okazaki. That's why we've introduced a seamless feedback and bug submission form, ensuring that your voice is heard and any glitches are swiftly addressed. Your insights drive the evolution of our village, shaping its destiny in profound ways.

Expanded Achievement Arsenal:
Elevate your Myoshu stature with a fresh array of achievements, each representing a milestone in your village's growth. These accolades await those who dare to leave their mark on the annals of Sengoku history. With each triumph, your legacy grows stronger, echoing through the ages.

Bug Squashing and Performance Enhancements:
Our artisans have tirelessly combed through the fabric of our game, stitching together solutions to reported bugs and enhancing overall performance. Your journey through Okazaki will now unfold with even greater seamlessness, allowing you to immerse yourself fully in the vibrant tapestry of Sengoku life.

Prepare to witness the unfolding tapestry of Okazaki's destiny as we continue to weave new features and enhancements into the fabric of "Matsudaira's Myoshu." Together, let us shape a legacy worthy of the Sengoku era's grandeur!

notes.title: Diplomacy, Trade, and Achievements Await in Okazaki!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Myoshu! It's time to unveil the latest strides in the development of "Matsudaira's Myoshu: A Sengoku Village Simulator." Your journey in the Sengoku realms is about to become even more engaging with these exciting updates.

Upgradeable Marketplace:
The heartbeat of your village, the marketplace, is now more dynamic than ever. Introducing the ability to build and upgrade your marketplace, attracting a diverse array of traders eager to exchange goods and contribute to the prosperity of Okazaki. Navigate the intricacies of trade and watch your village thrive.

Diplomacy Research:
Delve into the art of diplomacy with the introduction of Diplomacy Research. Currently trade has been added with more to come! Expand your influence and secure the prosperity of your village through the power of diplomacy.

New Achievements Unveiled:
Elevate your Myoshu legacy with a fresh set of achievements. These challenges span the spectrum of your leadership. Can you rise to the occasion and etch your name into the annals of Sengoku history? Eventually a total of 50 achievements plus 1 hidden will be added.

Bug Fixes and Performance Boosts:
Our diligent artisans have been hard at work addressing reported bugs and enhancing overall performance. Your journey in Okazaki will now be smoother than ever, ensuring a seamless experience as you navigate the challenges of the Sengoku period. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine and expand the world of "Matsudaira's Myoshu." May your village prosper, and your legacy endure!
